title: Short Interest in Apple Inc. (AAPL) Declines By 14.1%
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Oct 12th, 2018 // No Comments
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) was the recipient of a large decline in short interest during the month of September. As of September 28th, there was short interest totalling 40,204,115 shares, a decline of 14.1% from the September 14th total of 46,818,683 shares. Currently, 0.8% of the company’s shares are sold short. Based on an average trading volume of 34,804,592 shares, the days-to-cover ratio is presently 1.2 days.
Shares of NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $214.45 on Friday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a quick ratio of 1.24 and a current ratio of 1.31. The stock has a market cap of $1,109.54 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 23.41, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.99 and a beta of 1.36. Apple has a 1 year low of $150.24 and a 1 year high of $233.47. Get Apple alerts:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. The company had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $52.43 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.98% and a return on equity of 43.50%. The business’s revenue for the quarter was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same period in the prior year, the firm earned $1.67 earnings per share. Analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.76 EPS for the current fiscal year.
Several research analysts have recently weighed in on AAPL shares. BidaskClub raised shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, June 18th. Sanford C. Bernstein reissued a “neutral” rating and set a $190.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, June 25th. Barclays boosted their price target on shares of Apple from $161.00 to $175.00 and gave the company an “equal weight” rating in a research report on Tuesday, June 26th. Loop Capital boosted their price target on shares of Apple from $195.00 to $210.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Friday, July 6th. Finally, Royal Bank of Canada reissued a “buy” rating and set a $210.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, July 9th. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, nineteen have assigned a hold rating and thirty have given a buy rating to the company’s stock. The company has an average rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $221.63.

Following the transaction, the director now owns 1,153,283 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $238,245,202.14. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is available at this hyperlink . In the last three months, insiders have sold 564,185 shares of company stock worth $124,444,213. Corporate insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
